subject.title: feat(claude): add claude-bridge app-server harness extension

question: Should OpenClaw permanently bundle and own this Claude app-server harness, or require it to remain an external plugin using generic SDK contracts?
rationale: The answer determines package provenance, credential ownership, persistent-state architecture, release responsibility, security review, and how much provider-specific policy may enter core; code review cannot infer that product commitment.

options.title: External plugin
options.body: Keep the bridge and dependency outside core, move persistent state to plugin SQLite, and propose only missing generic SDK seams separately.

options.title: Bundled OpenClaw harness
options.body: Sponsor the runtime only after OpenClaw owns the package and approves its dependency, auth, SQLite migration, security, and upgrade contracts.

options.title: Use existing Claude paths
options.body: Close the implementation direction and invest in the Anthropic provider, Claude CLI, and ACP reliability instead.

recommendation.title: External plugin
recommendation.body: Keep the bridge and dependency outside core, move persistent state to plugin SQLite, and propose only missing generic SDK seams separately.

likelyOwner.reason: The product choice spans the agent runtime and plugin architecture surfaces with the strongest ownership signal in this history.
